system.description:
You coat your ammunition in a toxic poison and minor explosion meant to disable a group. Make a ranged taijutsu attack against a creature in range, dealing your [Weapons damage] +4d6 poison damage. Regardless of a hit or miss, the affected creature and all creatures within 10 feet of it, must make a Constitution saving throw as the Poison detonates. On a failed save, affected creatures gain a rank of Envenomed.

Chain 1: Creatures who failed their saving throws begin to cough and hack at the poisonous gas in the air becoming unable to speak or form Hand Seals (HS) until the end of their next turn.

Chain 2: A creature who already has ranks of Envenomed makes their save at disadvantage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6.
